title: 第25章 公平交易第26章 易容药膏
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
“你误会了！”
林铭摆摆手说道：
“我可不是让你传给我，而是要用美食和你交换，公平交易，童叟无欺，你想要交换，就可以交换，你不想交换也可以，我也不会强迫你进行交易！”
“那太好了！”
周封嘴角顿时扬起了笑容，赶紧说道：
“大人，这个真不能交易！”
“不交易就算了！”
林铭看起来也没有强迫周封的意思，让周封悬着的心总算是放下了。
“周封，我没记错的话，明天就是你在天牢之中的最后一天了？！”
“是，大人！”
周封点了点头。
“那太好了，今天晚上我可要好好招待你一下才是，你要知道这里是天牢，有不少人在这里是看不到女人的，他们也是有想法要发泄的，找不到女人怎么办？！就只能找男人了……晚上你等等，我给你安排几个身形强壮的，让他们好好地来服侍服侍你，说不定明天你一高兴，喜欢上了这种生活，让你走你都不走了呢？！”
林铭的话顿时让周封脸色发苦。
“大人！”
“哎！”
林铭制止了周封要说的话。
“别谢我，你我人在天牢之中相逢，这也算是缘分，这些都是我应该做的，我想想，应该将谁挪到你这个监牢之中呢？！”
林铭故作沉思状。
“大人，别……”
周封赶紧说着：

“别，我愿意交换，我愿意交换还不成么！？”
“真要交换？！”
林铭嘴角扬起了一丝笑意。
“我可不是你们妙手门的人，你将这易容术给了我，你还怎么去见列祖列宗？！”
“大人，您就别调笑小人了，这个好解决，只要让大人您成为妙手门的人不就行了么？！”
周封一脸苦涩地说着：
“我就是妙手门第三十七代掌门人，现在邀请大人为我妙手门外事长老，还请大人答应！”
“嘿嘿！”
林铭轻笑一声，毫不犹豫地一伸手。
“好办法，好，那我现在就是你们妙手门的外事长老了，功法拿来吧！”
周封却没有拿出东西来，拱手说道：
“林长老，您有所不知，本门的武学，我等是视若珍宝，这种东西，怎么能随身携带？！都放在了别人无法察觉的地方，你让我现在拿出来，我也真的拿不出来啊！”
“放在哪了？！告诉我，我去取！”
林铭追问着。
“这个……”
周封犹豫了一下，还是说道：
“大人请原谅，这具体的位置还请大人恕小人不能说！”
“耍我？！”
林铭脸色顿时阴沉了下来。
“好……看来你是准备加餐了……哼，我会让你好好体验一下的！”

林铭说完之后，就准备从这里离去。
“大人，您误会了！”
content_en:
"You misunderstood!"
Lin Ming waved his hand and said:
"I'm not asking you to pass it on to me, but I'm going to exchange it with you for delicious food. It's a fair trade, no bullying. If you want to trade, you can trade. If you don't want to trade, that's fine. I won't force you to trade!"
"That's great!"
Zhou Feng's lips suddenly turned into a smile, and he quickly said:
"Sir, this really cannot be traded!"
“Forget it if we don’t trade!”
Lin Ming didn't seem to have any intention of forcing Zhou Feng, which finally made Zhou Feng feel relieved.
"Zhou Feng, if I remember correctly, tomorrow will be your last day in the prison?!"
"Yes, sir!"
Zhou Feng nodded.
"That's great. I want to entertain you well tonight. You have to know that this is a prison. There are many people who can't see women here. They also have ideas to vent. What should they do if they can't find a woman?! They can only find men... Wait tonight, I will arrange a few strong men for you and let them serve you well. Maybe tomorrow you will be happy and like this kind of life. Even if you leave, you won't even leave?!"
Lin Ming's words immediately made Zhou Feng's face turn bitter.
"My lord!"
"Hey!"
Lin Ming stopped what Zhou Feng was about to say.
"Don't thank me. It's fate that you and I meet each other in the prison. These are all things I should do. Let me think about it, who should I move to your prison?!"
Lin Ming pretended to be deep in thought.
"Sir, don't..."
Zhou Feng said quickly:
"No, I am willing to exchange. I am willing to exchange, why not!?"
"Really want to exchange?!"
Lin Ming's lips curved into a smile.
"I'm not from your Miaoshou sect. You gave me this disguise technique. How can you go see your ancestors?!"
"Sir, please stop teasing me. This can be easily solved. I just need you to become a member of the Miaoshou Sect, right?"
Zhou Feng said with a bitter look:
"I am the thirty-seventh generation head of the Miaoshou Sect. Now I invite you to be the elder of my Miaoshou Sect. Please agree!"
"Hey!"
Lin Ming chuckled and reached out his hand without hesitation.
"Good idea, okay, then I am now the foreign affairs elder of your Miaoshou Sect. Bring me the skills!"
Zhou Feng didn't take out anything, he cupped his hands and said:
"Elder Lin, you don't know something. We regard our martial arts as a treasure. How can we carry this kind of thing with us?! It's all placed in a place where others can't notice it. If you ask me to take it out now, I really can't take it out!"
"Where is it?! Tell me and I'll get it!"
Lin Ming asked.
"This..."
Zhou Feng hesitated for a moment, then said:
"My lord, please forgive me, but I can't tell you the specific location!"
"You're kidding me?!"
Lin Ming's face suddenly darkened.
"Okay...it seems you are ready for extra food...hum, I will let you have a good experience!"
After Lin Ming finished speaking, he prepared to leave from here.
"Sir, you misunderstood!"
